content.short: Swap.coffee is a comprehensive DEX aggregator and toolkit on TON, offering smart routing and advanced trading strategies.
content.description: Swap.coffee is a versatile DeFi toolkit and DEX aggregator operating on the TON blockchain. It provides users with smart routing to ensure optimal trade execution across various liquidity pools, alongside advanced features such as limit orders on AMMs, Dollar-Cost Averaging (DCA) tools, and portfolio analytics. By consolidating these professional trading utilities into a user-friendly platform, Swap.coffee empowers TON users to manage their assets and execute strategies with greater precision and profitability.
